topics.name: Cloud-Architektur & Plattformen

items.title: Article: Governed Autonomous Intelligence for Mission-Critical Utility
items.summary: The article describes an architecture for agentic AI in regulated utility operations. Agents reason and propose actions, but a deterministic policy gate and a governed tool gateway control execution, with human approval where required. It covers an AWS reference implementation, grounding in runbooks, governed prediction, outcome validation, audit evidence, and phased autonomy. By Purnang Borah

items.title: AWS Open-Sources Emulator for Local Testing of 200+ Services by Coding Agents
items.summary: AWS Emulator is a generally available local HTTPS endpoint, generated from public Smithy API models, that lets developers and coding agents test against more than 200 AWS services without an account, with published fidelity scores and documented limits around IAM, regions, and in-memory state. By Daniel Dominguez

items.title: AWS Nitro Sandboxes Put Each EKS Pod in Its Own MicroVM with One RuntimeClass Field
items.summary: AWS has launched Nitro Sandboxes, running each opted-in EKS pod, ECS task or EC2 workload in its own Firecracker microVM with a separate kernel, enabled by one runtimeClassName field at no extra charge. A confidential mode adds attestation-gated key release. The documentation lists the trade-offs: no GPU passthrough, at most five sandboxes per vCPU, and half the compute on SMT instances. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Alpine Linux Users Urged to Patch OpenSSH Authentication Flaw
items.summary: A recently disclosed vulnerability in OpenSSH lets an unauthenticated attacker log into accounts that should have no usable password. The issue, named *sshole and tracked as CVE-2026-123158, affects Linux systems running OpenSSH with the musl C library and which don't use PAM. Security researchers now report that attackers are exploiting it in the wild. By Matt Saunders

items.title: Airbnb Introduces CASTLE for Training Natural Language Search Models with Synthetic Data
items.summary: Airbnb researchers have introduced CASTLE, a framework designed to address the cold-start problem in natural language search. The approach uses de-identified booking sessions and large language models (LLMs) to jointly generate synthetic search queries and relevance labels, enabling model training before sufficient real search traffic is available. By Robert Krzaczyński

items.title: GitHub Rebuilds the Copilot App's Diff Surface to Open Million-Line Pull Requests Without Jank
items.summary: GitHub engineers rebuilt the diff view in the Copilot app to handle a pull request with 2,200 files, over a million changed lines and 400 inline comments. The design separates fixed-height code rows from variable-height comment blocks, which are measured in batches near the viewport. Performance is checked through CI budgets and automated app runs. By Daniel Curtis
